type: logical fake-quant / dequant QUALITY ablation (NOT a physical serving benchmark)
question: Holding K3 / G32 / R4 / META8g64 fixed, how does quality change as V precision changes? In particular, is V=2 justified relative to neighbouring V precisions? V2 is not presupposed best.

config.name: K3V1 META8g64 G32 R4 (V-bit ablation of rabit2)
K3V3 META8g64 G32 R4 (V-bit ablation of rabit2)
K3V4 META8g64 G32 R4 (V-bit ablation of rabit2)

pre_registered_substitute.rule: V4 replaces V1 ONLY if V1 fails the uniform correctness gate (crash inside the check, NaN / Inf in the dequantized KV, out-of-range or all-identical codes) -- identified before any quality metric is examined. V1's quality, however poor, is never grounds for substitution. A substitution is not automatic: the runner stops and reports the failure mode for review; the substitution is then reported explicitly.

correctness_gate.where: inside every derived script: per layer right after quantization (codes) and after dequantization, before scoring (finite KV)
correctness_gate.applies_to: every quantized method (V1, V2 control, V3; V4 if ever run) -- uniformly; bf16 is never quantized
checks: quantized codes not all identical within a layer's K or V state (degeneracy)
every dequantized K / V tensor finite (no NaN / Inf)
correctness_gate.evidence: one EXP8_CORRECTNESS_OK line per quantize call; EXP8_CORRECTNESS_FAILURE raises

common.seed: torch.manual_seed(0) and torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(0) in every script

continuation_ppl.dataset: WikiText-2 test (raw text: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pytorch/examples/main/word_language_model/data/wikitext-2/test.txt), non-empty stripped lines joined in blocks of 64
continuation_ppl.selection: deterministic: the first samples x (context + eval) tokens of the tokenized stream, split into consecutive non-overlapping spans
continuation_ppl.procedure: teacher-forced: prefill the 1024-token context, quantize/dequantize its KV once, score the 128 continuation tokens (first logit from the prefill)
continuation_ppl.metric: PPL (exp of mean token cross-entropy) and PPL delta % vs bf16

niah.dataset: synthetic needle-in-a-haystack: WikiText-2 test as distractor filler; needle 'The hidden secret code is RABIT-7291'
niah.selection: deterministic: every (context length, depth) pair; needle inserted at round(filler x depth)
niah.quantized_prefix_tokens: prompt length - 1 (the last prompt token is fed at the first decode step)
niah.metric: exact-match accuracy: regex RABIT-\d{4} on the decoded answer equals RABIT-7291
niah.warmup: one BF16 warm-up case at 4096 tokens, not reported

passage_retrieval.truncation: if longer, keep the first 8192 and last 8192 tokens
passage_retrieval.prompt: LongBench official template via the tokenizer chat template
passage_retrieval.metric: LongBench official retrieval score (fraction of numbers in the prediction equal to the target paragraph id), mean x 100

hotpotqa.selection: deterministic: examples with length >= 8000 (bucket 8k+), filtered positions [0, 20)
hotpotqa.truncation: if longer, keep the first 8192 and last 8192 tokens
hotpotqa.prompt: LongBench official template via the tokenizer chat template
hotpotqa.metric: LongBench qa_f1_score (max over reference answers), mean x 100

qasper.selection: deterministic: examples with length >= 8000 (bucket 8k+), filtered positions [0, 24)
qasper.truncation: if longer, keep the first 8192 and last 8192 tokens
qasper.prompt: LongBench official template via the tokenizer chat template
qasper.metric: LongBench qa_f1_score (max over reference answers), mean x 100

control_reproduction.configuration_equality: EXACT: the V2 control is the canonical rabit2 config (compiled and compared)
control_reproduction.numerical_reproduction: within the frozen tolerances below (copied from the accepted Experiment 1 methodology); applied to bf16 and the V2 control; never changed after the run starts

single_example_flip.passage_retrieval: 1 of 10 samples = up to 10.0 points > 1.0 -> fails
single_example_flip.hotpotqa: one example's F1 moves the mean by up to 5.0 points (1/20)
single_example_flip.qasper: one example's F1 moves the mean by up to 4.17 points (1/24)
single_example_flip.rule: 1.0-point tolerance is a tight drift detector, identical to Exp1 / Exp7

control_reproduction.target_source: results/summary.json and results/quality/*.log (canonical), pinned in the accepted Experiment 1 runner

logical_storage_expectations.label: LOGICAL packed prefix-KV storage (payload bits + uint8-group metadata + BF16 residual); NOT physical allocator capacity
logical_storage_expectations.formula: identical to Experiment 7's frozen formula with k_bits = 3 and v_bits varied: per layer V payload = ceil(8*Lq*128*v_bits/8) (Lq = prefix - 4, V grouped along head_dim so no sequence padding); K payload, all metadata and the BF16 residual do not depend on v_bits

matches_expected.rule: observed V1 / V2 / V3 avg logical KV MB within the relative tolerance of expected_avg_logical_kv_mb

execution_gates: all four rows (bf16, V1, V2, V3) present
per-method counts equal the frozen counts
EXP8_CORRECTNESS_OK lines == expected quantize calls for V1, V2, V3; no failure marker
bf16 and V2 control within the frozen tolerances of the canonical targets
protected paths clean; Exp6 identical to 0f5f6ef; Exp7 identical to 6ce79ed
stop at the first failing benchmark; no retry
